name: jyu_slam_front
desc: Same image, same pose, body, colors and size. Change only the face to match his usual face more closely: very thick, bold, angular solid black eyebrows slanting down toward the nose in a grumpy frown, small half-lidded eyes under them with a dark outline, a big glossy black nose, a short boxy cream muzzle, and a small grumpy closed mouth. He still faces the viewer and looks down with a heavy, smug gaze. Same outline and pixel art style.
